subject: Timebox cleanse: claim or escalate stale Q3 opportunities (close-date verification needed)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Timebox cleanse: claim or escalate stale Q3 opportunities (close-date verification needed)

Team —

Quick timebox: finance asked that we reduce forecast variance before the end of Q3. Attached is a short export (q3_stale_ops_list.csv) showing 7 opportunities with close dates in July/Aug that either have no recent activity or conflicting evidence in SFDC. Please take one of two actions by EOD Thursday 8/13:

- "Claim & verify" — update SFDC stage, expected close date, and add one-line evidence in the Notes (what did you ask the buyer and when).
- "Escalate to CS/Prod" — if the deal requires SOW/technical acceptance, mark as "Needs SOW" and /cc CS.

Key asks (top 4 on the export):
- CRUC-1052 (Crucial Care) — $86k ARR — close date 2026-07-30 (no recent touch)
- NIMB-210 — $120k ARR — close date 2026-08-11 (pending procurement approval)
- STELL-33 — $45k ARR — close date 2026-08-04 (contact not responding)
- MEDV-88 — $200k ARR — close date 2026-08-31 (SOW outstanding)

Why this matters: FP&A needs reconciled commit buckets by 8/16 to finalize the July close. If these are not claimed or reclassified, finance will conservatively remove them from the commit column which will materially affect our near-term cadence.

Please reply on-thread with your action and the SFDC link for proof. I'll run a one-time sweep Friday morning and will reassign any unclaimed items to the stale list.

Thanks — concise replies appreciated.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
